children: Harbour Energy's additional $150 million share buyback and faster deleveraging reinforce the stock's attractiveness, Barclays analyst Lydia Rainforth writes. The London-listed oil and gas company benefits from stronger prices at a time of record production. Meanwhile, BASF's shareholding has materially reduced, removing an overhang from the stock, she notes. Shares fall 3.6% to 269.8 pence.(adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
